definitions: Trains (someone) to obey rules or a code of behavior, typically using punishment to correct disobedience.
Punishes or penalizes (someone) for an offense or misbehavior.
Brings (a field of study or activity) to a state of order and control.
examples: The coach disciplines his team members for tardiness.
The school board disciplines teachers who violate policy.
She disciplines her mind to focus on her studies.
